## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, deps, repo maintenance
- [ ] `refactor` — no behavior change
- [ ] other (describe above)

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for this change
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, `README.md`, or inline as relevant)
- [ ] ADR added under `docs/decisions/` if this is a consequential
      architectural decision
- [ ] If `.proto` files changed: ran `buf breaking` locally and confirmed
      no unintended breaking changes (or bumped the API version
      deliberately)
- [ ] If a migration was added: reviewed the generated SQL by hand, not
      just trusted the generator
- [ ] `tasks.md` updated to reflect this work (required for agent-assisted
      PRs; appreciated for everyone else)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, `.env` values, or credentials included in this
      diff
